title: Operator CLI: trigger provisioning runs + safe stage re-run (dry-run, dashboard links)
author: Gabe Wilson
release_notes: Internal operator tooling only. Adds `rw fleet provisioning run` and `rw fleet provisioning rerun` commands with dry-run + links to readiness dashboards.
description: Context: As part of the provision-to-ready automation sprint, operators need a minimal, safe interface to (a) trigger a provisioning run for a Dedicated pool expansion and (b) re-run specific stages without clicking around multiple UIs. This PR adds provisioning commands to the operator CLI and wires them to the control-plane provisioning API (from PR-48233) while respecting RBAC and audit requirements. What this adds: New CLI command group: `rw fleet provisioning`. `rw fleet provisioning run --pool-id <pool> --reason "..." [--requested-by <email>] [--dry-run] [--watch] [--format json|table] triggers a provisioning run and prints: run_id, correlation_id, current state, and deep links to (1) the Dedicated Readiness dashboard (time-to-ready, stage breakdown) and (2) the control plane run status page. `rw fleet provisioning rerun --run-id <run> --stage <Provisioning|Imaging|Bootstrapping|Validating> [--dry-run] [--watch] safely requests a stage re-run (server-side guardrails enforce state machine legality; CLI performs an additional preflight to reduce operator foot-guns). `--dry-run` does not call the API; it validates flags, resolves pool/run metadata, and prints the request payload and intended state transition. `--watch` polls run status + streams latest provisioning events (stage start/finish/failure) with backoff; on failure prints the normalized error category and a runbook pointer if provided by the API. Output formats: human table by default; `--format json` for piping into other tooling. Security/RBAC: Uses the existing operator auth flow (OIDC device flow) and passes the operator identity explicitly in headers for audit log attribution. Commands are gated behind `fleet.provisioning.write` (run/rerun) and `fleet.provisioning.read` (watch/status). No secrets are printed; dry-run redacts tokens and headers. UX details: Commands print a single "next actions" block (links + suggested follow-up commands). Link generation includes pool_id/run_id + correlation_id query params to improve cross-system debugging. Error messages prefer actionable text (quota/IAM/DNS/TLS/GPU health) and include the control-plane error code when available. Files/areas: Adds a new cobra command set under `cmd/rw/fleet/provisioning/*`. Adds an API client wrapper in `internal/controlplaneclient/provisioning.go`. Adds unit tests with httptest for success/failure cases and for dry-run redaction. Adds minimal internal docs: `docs/internal/operator-cli/fleet-provisioning.md`. Example usage: `rw fleet provisioning run --pool-id dp-usw2-cust-043 --reason "add 16x H100" --watch` and `rw fleet provisioning rerun --run-id prun_01HPX... --stage Validating --dry-run`. Notes / follow-ups: This intentionally does not add pause/resume controls (tracked separately) and does not attempt to implement any local retries beyond watch polling; the provisioning service remains source-of-truth for retries/backoff. Requested changes addressed: reviewers asked for a `--format json` output mode, stronger dry-run redaction, and a clearer rerun stage allowlist; all included here. Testing: `go test ./cmd/rw/... ./internal/controlplaneclient/...` plus a small set of golden tests for table output. CI includes lint + unit tests; no integration environment required for merge.
commits: cmd/rw: add `fleet provisioning` command group (cobra scaffolding + help text)
controlplaneclient: add provisioning run/rerun/watch client + typed errors
cli: implement --dry-run (payload preview + redaction) and --format json|table
cli: add link builder for readiness dashboard + control-plane run page

docs: internal operator CLI guide for provisioning commands
conversation: Vanessa Ortiz: Can we ensure rerun only allows specific stages and fails fast if the run is already Ready/Failed? Also please include the Linear key in the help output examples.
Gabe Wilson (author): Added an explicit allowlist for `--stage` + preflight that blocks rerun when state is Ready/Failed. Updated help examples to include ENG-2750 and a standard pool_id example.
Rafael Mendes: Watch mode: please avoid tight polling loops; add jitter/backoff and print the correlation_id prominently. Also, dry-run should not hit any privileged endpoints.

Gabe Wilson (author): Implemented exponential backoff with jitter (max 30s) and prints correlation_id in the header line. Dry-run now only validates inputs and renders payload; it does not call run/rerun endpoints (it will optionally resolve pool metadata via read-only endpoint when `--resolve` is set). Default dry-run performs zero network calls.
Ethan Park: The link URLs should point to the new run details route in the control plane UI. Also, please include `--format json` so we can wire this into the Slack bot later.
Gabe Wilson (author): Updated link template to `/fleet/provisioning/runs/<run_id>` and added `--format json` with a stable schema (run_id, pool_id, stage, state, correlation_id, links[]).
Kira Thompson: Docs: include a short section for "common failures" and what to do next (e.g., IAM 403, quota 422).
Gabe Wilson (author): Added a "Common failures" section with error codes -> next actions and pointers to runbooks. Also included example outputs for table and json.

Allison Grant: Please ensure we don't include any high-cardinality labels in logs/metrics emitted by the CLI. Ideally CLI should not emit metrics at all; just structured logs at info level with redaction.
Gabe Wilson (author): CLI does not emit metrics; only structured logs (zap) with redaction on headers/tokens. Removed run_id from default info logs unless `--verbose` is set.
Vanessa Ortiz: Looks good; ship it.
